title: OXYGEN Email Infrastructure
description: Plan, set up and run OXYGEN cold email sending infrastructure: playbooks by market (Google/Microsoft mix, inbox count sized from the TAM), lookalike domains and DNS, managed and imported mailboxes, sender profiles and photos, OAuth, warm-up, recovery, egress and wind-down; also connect a customer's own inbox for Unibox history and CRM.

email-infra-setup.title: Set up cold email infrastructure
email-infra-setup.label: Cold email setup
email-infra-setup.summary: A separate domain and two warmed inboxes that keep your main domain safe, priced first.
email-infra-setup.prompt: Set up email sending for cold outreach that keeps our main domain safe. Show me what a separate domain and two inboxes cost before buying anything, and make sure they warm up before any campaign sends from them.
trigger_phrases: I need sending domains and mailboxes for outbound
How do I send cold email without burning my domain?
Buy me some inboxes for a cold email campaign
Stand up a warmed mailbox pool for outreach
What do sending inboxes cost per month?
email-infra-setup.business_case: Cold email from your main company domain can push all of your company's email into spam. This prices, then after your approval buys, a separate look-alike domain with two inboxes in your name that warm up for 14 days before any campaign uses them.
email-infra-setup.outcome: A quote for one look-alike domain and two inboxes; after approval, the domain registered with SPF, DKIM and DMARC set, two inboxes under your name warming up, and sending ready for outbound-pilot-50 after 14 days.
email-infra-setup.leading_metric: inboxes warmed for 14+ days, then hard bounces under 2% once sending
email-infra-setup.benchmark: 2026-10-04 audit: look-alike domains cost 700 credits a year (.co) or 1,250 (.com); a managed Google inbox is 500 credits ($5) a month with warm-up included, so one domain and two inboxes cost about 1,700-2,250 credits the first month and 1,000 a month after. Two warm inboxes send up to about 50 emails a day.

effort.time_to_value: quote in 5 minutes; inboxes the same day; sending after 14 days of warm-up
effort.cadence: once; add a domain and two inboxes when daily send caps run out

credits.pilot: 0 to quote; domain + 2 inboxes ~1,700-2,250 the first month
credits.full: domain 700-1,250 a year + 500 per inbox a month, warm-up included

prerequisites.detail: Inboxes you already have on a separate sending domain and their warm-up; two warmed ones mean you can skip this play
A paid plan, from $49 a month, and credits for the first month (about 1,700-2,250 for a domain and two inboxes); the quote itself is free
The real first and last name the inboxes send as; the inbox provider stamps it permanently

journey.title: Outbound infrastructure
journey.description: Domains, inboxes, warmup, sender posture — reviewed and approved before anything is bought or sent.
journey.seed_message: Inspect my current sending setup (domains, inboxes, warmup, senders, caps, deliverability) and propose what's missing for a safe cold-email motion. Show quotes and costs — do not buy or change anything without my approval.
